article.headline: Gibbs-Lawhorn scores career-high 33, UNLV beats Boise State 89-85 in OT
article.description: — Dra Gibbs-Lawhorn had a career-high 33 points, six assists and five rebounds to help UNLV beat Boise State 89-85 in overtime on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Gibbs-Lawhorn scores career-high 33, UNLV beats Boise State 89-85 in OT
article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Dra Gibbs-Lawhorn had a career-high 33 points, six assists and five rebounds to help UNLV beat Boise State 89-85 in overtime on Tuesday night. Kimani Hamilton scored seven of his 16 points in overtime and Howie Fleming Jr. finished with 14 points for UNLV (8-8, 3-2 Mountain West Conference). Drew Fielder led Boise State (9-8, 1-5) with 23 points and Andrew Meadow scored 11. The Broncos have lost four in a row. Fielder hit a 3-pointer from the right wing with 0.3 seconds left in regulation to make it 76-all and force OT. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
